en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing an opulent, elongated ceremonial hall with a richly patterned ceiling, tall arched wall panels covered in mosaics, and large windows on one side. At the far end stands a throne-like arrangement before a huge mosaic wall. The printing along the bottom edge identifies the location as Stockholm and names the hall "Gyllene Salen" (the Golden Hall).
